lines.text: Many learners say: I arrived to school late.
Better: I arrived at school late.

native.tip: Em português “cheguei à escola” usa “a”, que parece “to”; em inglês, com “arrive”, usa-se “at” ou “in”.
native.caption: Cuidado com este erro comum! 😬 Muita gente diz “I arrived to school late.” O certo é “I arrived at school late.” O “a” de “chegar a” parece “to”, mas em inglês o certo é “arrive at”. Ouça o Carlos e repita! Treine mais no app Lexkite.
native.comment: Resposta: “at”. Treine mais com um quiz grátis aqui: {link}

en.tip: “Cheguei à escola” uses “a”, which looks like “to”; in English “arrive” takes “at” or “in”.
en.caption: Watch out for this common mistake! Many people say “I arrived to school late.” The right way is “I arrived at school late.” The “a” of “chegar a” looks like “to”, but English says “arrive at”. Listen to Carlos and repeat! Practice more in the Lexkite app.
